title: A Very Cubic Christmas with Minecraft VooDoo Magic
description:
It's that time of the year again on the Wavetech Server, time for the annual Secret Santa where all the members of Wavetech get together and make insane builds for eachother. This year we will be sprinkling in some cursed VooDoo magic to finally get revenge against a menace of the technical community.
